repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Two refinements from PR #36437's delta review on head d1522bfb.
- N10: the editor's "own end" of a group depends on the stored read made at mount. While that read is pending or has failed, no entry is marked contributed, so an entry added at a group's end is drawn after the contributed run but stored before it. Nothing wrong is written.
- N9 is wider than first written. In a group that another package contributes, 「添加菜单项」 and 「移到分组」 draw the entry first in that group, but the save puts it at the end of the stored top level.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

N12, added to this card's list. Found by the L2 delta record 7085270448 on PR #36437 (head effe780b2), graded non-blocking. Filed by the seat.

**What happens.** In design mode, start dragging an own menu entry with the pointer, press Escape while the button is still held, then release on the same entry's link more than 300 ms later. The release is read as a plain click, and the entry's page opens as an in-app navigation. Nothing is lost and there is no full page load, but the user did not ask to open it.

**Where.** `DesignModeMenu.tsx`: the window-capture click cancel holds for 300 ms after a drag ends or is cancelled, and an Escape cancel starts that window at the key press, not at the release.

**Done when.** A click whose pointerdown began a drag that was cancelled opens nothing, whatever the time between the cancel and the release; a plain click on the link still opens its page. Pin it with a control.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

N13 and N14, added to this card's list. Found live by the L1 delta 7085492409 on PR #36437 (head effe780b), graded non-blocking. Filed by the seat.

- **N13. Enter on a menu entry in design mode starts a keyboard move, not the page.** dnd-kit's keyboard sensor takes Enter and Space as start keys, so a keyboard user cannot open an entry's page while the mode is on; Escape cancels the move. It has been so since the drag arrived. Done when: decide which key opens and which moves (for example Space only to start a move) and say it in the editor's help; pin the chosen keys.
- **N14. A drop far from every entry still lands next to the nearest one.** The editor uses `closestCenter`, so a release over empty page body moves the entry rather than cancelling. Done when: a drop outside the menu's area changes nothing, or the editor shows where the entry will land before release.

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

N15 and N16, added to this card's list. Found by the L2 delta record 7085793985 on PR #36437 (head f68c14b35), where they are numbered N13 and N14; graded non-blocking. Filed by the seat.

- **N15. Two of the drag-flag clears have no pin.** The editor clears its drag flag on a new pointerdown and on a window pointercancel, but only the pointerup path has a case; removing either of the other two lines leaves every test green. Done when: each path has a case that goes red without it.
- **N16. A mouse press during a held keyboard move lets a link open.** In design mode, pick an entry up with Enter or Space and, before dropping it, click an entry link with the mouse: the press clears the drag flag, so the link opens while the move is still held. Nothing is written. Done when: a click during a held keyboard move opens nothing (or ends the move first), pinned.
